summary.text: Monique Priestley is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont State Senate in the Orange District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent John Benson.
She currently represents Orange-2 in the Vermont House of Representatives and is an executive director of a nonprofit.

paragraphs.text: Priestley graduated from Oxbow High School and earned an associate degree in graphic design and a B.A. in digital media from Northern Vermont University-Lyndon, and a master's of communication in digital media from the University of Washington.
Her career experience includes working as executive director of The Space On Main, a nonprofit, and as director of digital for CampusCE Corporation in Seattle.

Priestley has chaired the Green Mountain Economic Development Corporation and Vital Communities, co-chaired the Bradford Business Association and served on several other boards, including the Vermont Council on Rural Development and the Cohase Chamber of Commerce.

She took office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and was assigned to the Information Technology Oversight, Joint Legislative Child Protection Oversight and Judicial Rules committees for 2023-2024.
